gameGroups.title: Four by Four
gameGroups.description: Sort 16 figures into 4 groups of 4 based on what they have in common. You get 4 mistakes before it's game over.
gameGroups.rule1: • Select 4 figures that share a common trait and submit.
gameGroups.rule2: • Find all 4 groups to win. 4 wrong guesses and you lose.
gameGroups.rule3: • Each figure belongs to exactly one group. Even if they seem to fit multiple, there is only one correct answer.
